brief: Foster twin stainless-clad cores bracket three suspended black-framed glass office blocks, with recessed louver belts, panoramic end lifts, a13.85m glazed lobby and an open20m crown below a curved metal bridge bearing current blue Moeve lettering.

Completed GMS/Foster photos constrain the cladding and genuinely open crown. The as-built248.3m architectural height replaces the early250m figure; the early215m cornice differs from construction/modelled219.7m roof.
reconstruction.facade: Individual steel sheets, black Vierendeel spandrels, fine curtain-wall mullions, dense recessed ventilation, panoramic glass strips and curved crown panel seams are explicit exterior geometry. Current blue lowercase roof lettering is an original polygonal reconstruction from the owner2025 report.

District restores8side doors/12side lettering, four-course wide glazing/panel bands and2.5m louvers.
